sources: sec edgar submissions api, 8-K item 2.02 acceptance times

history.basis: all 28 prior print(s) on this CIK were filed under a former name before 2026-08-27, so they belong to a predecessor entity and are not this company's reaction history

event_plausibility.reason: UPGRADE. Date and session confirmed by Palo Alto Networks' own press release for a 2026-09-01 after-close release (webcast 4:30 p.m. ET). The 'unknown' verdict came from history.n=0, and that zero is a RECORDS BUG, not a cadence problem: priced_in.py discarded all 28 prior prints on CIK 0001327567 as 'filed under a former name before 2026-08-27'. PANW has not changed its name. A company-issued scheduling release is stronger evidence the event exists than any cadence inference, so the event-existence flag goes to fits_cadence. The thin history is NOT forgiven by this: hist_q stays 0 and still costs the name 40% of baseline_quality in the right term.

amended_from.reason: fewer than 3 prior prints to infer a cadence from

event_plausibility.amended_by: edge sweep, company-sourced; before any hunter launched

options.event_implied_move_basis: 9.05% straddle over 3 calendar days less 5.81% of ordinary 20d-realised movement, subtracted in variance
options.skew_note: IV(25d put) - IV(25d call). Positive = the market is paying more for downside protection than for upside.

deadband_basis: one day at 20d realised vol (no earnings history on EDGAR)
deadband_note: A realised move inside this band is scored as no-direction rather than as a miss.
expected_move_basis: option straddle net of ordinary vol, front expiry

baseline_quality.note: thin means there is no reliable statement of what the market priced, so a confident call on this name cannot be justified by the baseline.
